description_en: Transfers a call to a phone number using single-step or dual-step transfer
description_zh: 通话单\双步转交到电话
kebab_example: aliyun scsp transfer-call-to-phone --client-token 46c1341e-2648-447a-9b11-70b6a298d94d --instance-id ccc_xp_pre-cn-000 --account-name 123@123.com --caller 9065446 --callee 136098792 --call-id 7719786 --job-id 7719787 --connection-id 7719788 --hold-connection-id 0 --type 1 --is-single-transfer true --caller-phone example-string --callee-phone example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: TransferCallToPhone

parameters.help_en: The unique client request ID for idempotency verification. You can use a UUID to generate this ID
parameters.help_zh: 客户请求唯一id，用于幂等校验，可以用uuid生成
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the AICCS instance. You can view this ID in the Intelligent Contact Center console
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID，在智能联络中心控制台上可以看到
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The agent account name (agent logon name)
parameters.help_zh: 坐席账号名称（坐席登录名）
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en: The caller number for the hotline transfer
parameters.name: caller

parameters.help_en: The callee number for the hotline transfer
parameters.name: callee

parameters.help_en: The acid from the WebSocket message after an inbound call is received
parameters.name: call_id

parameters.help_en: The jobId from the WebSocket message after an inbound call is received
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en: The connId from the WebSocket message after an inbound call is received
parameters.name: connection_id

parameters.help_en: The holdConnId from the WebSocket message after an inbound call is received. This parameter is required only for dual-step transfers
parameters.help_zh: 入呼后，websocket中的holdConnId（ 仅在双步转时传入）
parameters.name: hold_connection_id

parameters.help_en:
The transfer type. Valid values:
1: single-step transfer
2: dual-step transfer

Default value: 1
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use single-step transfer. Valid values:
true: Single-step transfer.
false: Dual-step transfer.

Default value: true
parameters.help_zh: true:单步转，false:双步转，默认单步转
parameters.name: is_single_transfer
